member.summary: Allocate a 3D blob analysis context.
member.param: Specifies the identifier of the system on which to allocate the 3D blob analysis context.
Specifies the type of 3D blob analysis context to allocate.
Reserved for future expansion and must be set to M_DEFAULT .

Specifies the address of the variable in which to write the 3D blob analysis context identifier or specifies the data type that the function should use to return the 3D blob analysis context identifier.
member.returns: The returned value is the 3D blob analysis context identifier either as a standard identifier ( MIL_ID) or a smart identifier ( MIL_UNIQUE_3DBLOB_ID). If allocation fails, M_NULL is returned (or nullptr ifM_UNIQUE_ID was specified).

member.name: M:Matrox.MatroxImagingLibrary.MIL.M3dblobCalculate(Matrox.MatroxImagingLibrary.MIL_ID,Matrox.MatroxImagingLibrary.MIL_ID,Matrox.MatroxImagingLibrary.MIL_ID,System.Int64,System.Int64)
member.summary: Perform 3D blob analysis calculations.
member.param: Specifies the identifier of the 3D blob analysis context that specifies the feature(s) to calculate, and other settings related to the 3D blob analysis operation. The context must have been previously allocated using M3dblobAlloc with M_CALCULATE_CONTEXT.

Specifies the identifier of the 3D-processable point cloud container from which the blobs originate. This must be the same container previously passed to M3dblobSegment, and its confidence component must not have been modified since then. If the segmentation was performed using a label image instead, this can be any container as long as the size of its range component is the same as the label image.

Specifies the identifier of the 3D blob analysis result buffer that holds the blob segmentation, and in which to store results. The result buffer must have been previously allocated using M3dblobAllocResult.
Specifies the label or index of the blob(s) for which to calculate features, or specifies that you are calculating features for all blobs. This parameter must be set to one of the following values:
Reserved for future expansion and must be set to M_DEFAULT .

Specifies the label or index of the blob(s) from which to copy results, or specifies that you are copying general results for all blobs for which data is stored in the source result buffer.

member.name: M:Matrox.MatroxImagingLibrary.MIL.M3dblobDraw3d(Matrox.MatroxImagingLibrary.MIL_ID,Matrox.MatroxImagingLibrary.MIL_ID,Matrox.MatroxImagingLibrary.MIL_ID,System.Int64,Matrox.MatroxImagingLibrary.MIL_ID,System.Int64,System.Int64)
member.summary: Draw blobs and blob features into a 3D graphics list.
member.param: Specifies the identifier of the draw 3D blob analysis context that specifies the features to draw and how to draw them.

Specifies the identifier of the 3D-processable point cloud container from which to retrieve the blobs to draw. This must be the same container previously passed to M3dblobSegment, and its confidence component must not have been modified since then. If the segmentation was performed using a label image instead, this can be any container as long as the size of its range component is the same as the label image.

Specifies the identifier of the 3D blob analysis result buffer from which to retrieve calculated results and/or information about the blobs. The result buffer must have been previously allocated using M3dblobAllocResult.
Specifies the label or index of the blob whose points and/or calculated features you want to draw, or specifies all blobs.

Specifies the identifier of the 3D graphics list in which to draw. You can specify a 3D graphics list that you have previously allocated using M3dgraAlloc, or you can specify the identifier of the 3D display's internal graphics list (inquired using M3ddispInquire with M_3D_GRAPHIC_LIST_ID).
Specifies the label of the 3D graphic in the 3D graphics list to use as the annotation's parent.
Reserved for future expansion and must be set to M_DEFAULT .
member.returns: Returns the parent label of all 3D graphics that the function added to the 3D graphics list. If the specified 3D blob analysis result buffer does not contain a blob segmentation, a node 3D graphic is added to the graphics list and the node's label is returned.

member.name: M:Matrox.MatroxImagingLibrary.MIL.M3dblobExtract(Matrox.MatroxImagingLibrary.MIL_ID,Matrox.MatroxImagingLibrary.MIL_ID,System.Int64,Matrox.MatroxImagingLibrary.MIL_ID,System.Int64,System.Int64)
member.summary: Populate a container with the specified blob(s).
member.param: Specifies the identifier of the 3D-processable point cloud container from which to extract the blobs. This must be the same container previously passed to M3dblobSegment, and its confidence component must not have been modified since then. If the segmentation was performed using a label image instead, this can be any container as long as the size of the container's range component is the same as the label image.
Specifies the identifier of the 3D blob analysis result buffer in which the blob segmentation is stored. The result buffer must have been previously allocated using M3dblobAllocResult.
Specifies the label or index of the blob to extract, or specifies to extract all blobs. This parameter must be set to one of the following values:
Specifies the identifier of the destination point cloud container in which to save the extracted blobs.
Specifies how to organize the destination point cloud.
Specifies whether to apply an extract operation to all components with the same dimensions as component M_COMPONENT_RANGE.

member.summary: Merge point clouds using the results of a previous call to M3dregCalculate.
member.param: Specifies the identifier of the pairwise 3D registration result buffer. The pairwise 3D registration result buffer must have been successfully allocated using M3dregAllocResult, and contain the result of a successful call to M3dregCalculate.

Specifies the address of the array containing the identifiers of the point cloud containers. The point clouds must be 3D-processable. You can check that the point clouds are 3D-processable using MbufInquireContainer with M_3D_PROCESSABLE. You can set some entries in the array to M_NULL to merge a subset of the point clouds.
Specifies the size of the array passed to ContainerBufIdArrayPtr.

Specifies the identifier of the destination container in which to store the transformed and merged point clouds. The container must have been previously allocated using MbufAllocContainer with M_PROC.
Specifies the identifier of a 3D image processing subsampling context. This context is used to subsample the resulting point cloud after the merging is complete.
Specifies whether to merge points from all components (in all specified point clouds) with the same dimensions as the point cloud's M_COMPONENT_RANGE component.

Specifies the operation to perform within the specified code context.
Specifies the code type of the code model to add or find in the code context. Note that if the Operation parameter is set to M_RESET_FROM_DETECTED_RESULTS or M_DELETE, set this parameter to M_NULL .

Specifies the instance or the index of the code model, depending on the operation and whether a specific code type is specified. Note that if the Operation parameter is set to M_ADD or M_DELETE, set this parameter to M_NULL .
Specifies additional information required to perform the operation. When not performing an M_RESET_FROM_DETECTED_RESULTS operation, set this parameter to M_DEFAULT.
Specifies the address in which to return or from which to read the code model identifier, depending on operation.
member.returns: The returned value is the identifier of the (first) code model for a successful M_ADD, M_ADD_IF_NOT_THERE, M_RESET_FROM_DETECTED_RESULTS, or M_FIND operation; if the model could not be added/found, M_NULL is returned, unless performing an M_ADD_IF_NOT_THERE operation. In the latter case, if the model already exists, the MIL identifier of the existing model will be returned. The returned value is M_NULL for an M_DELETE or anM_DELETE_ALL operation.

member.name: M:Matrox.MatroxImagingLibrary.MIL.MgraVectorsGrid(Matrox.MatroxImagingLibrary.MIL_ID,Matrox.MatroxImagingLibrary.MIL_ID,Matrox.MatroxImagingLibrary.MIL_ID,Matrox.MatroxImagingLibrary.MIL_ID,Matrox.MatroxImagingLibrary.MIL_INT,System.Int64,System.Double,System.Int64)
member.summary: Draw vectors at equally spaced positions in an image, or add them to a 2D graphics list.
member.param: Specifies the identifier of the 2D graphics context. This parameter must be set to one of the following values:
Specifies the identifier of a valid image buffer in which to draw the vectors or the identifier of a valid 2D graphics list in which to add the vectors.
Specifies the identifier of a valid image buffer containing the values corresponding to the displacements, in the X-direction, of the vectors to draw.
Specifies the identifier of a valid image buffer containing the values corresponding to the displacements, in the Y-direction, of the vectors to draw.

Specifies a value that establishes the positions for which vectors are drawn. MIL always draws a vector for the first position (0,0), and then draws subsequent vectors that are a multiple of the specified stride, in both the X- and Y-direction. For example, if you specify a stride of 2, a vector is drawn for position (0,0), and for every second position after that, in the X-direction and in the Y-direction. Specifying a stride of 1 draws a vector for every position. Increasing the stride increases the space between the vectors drawn.
Specifies how to use the scale value ( ScaleValue) to scale the vectors.
Specifies the value by which to scale the vectors, according to the specified mode ( ScaleMode).
Specifies how to configure the arrowheads of the vectors, and how to handle null vectors.

member.name: M:Matrox.MatroxImagingLibrary.MIL.MimBinarize(Matrox.MatroxImagingLibrary.MIL_ID,Matrox.MatroxImagingLibrary.MIL_ID,System.Int64,System.Double,System.Double)
member.summary: Perform a point-to-point binary threshold operation.
member.param: Specifies the identifier of the data source of the operation.

Specifies either the lower limit of the selected condition or the minimum value to use when establishing the threshold.
Specifies either the upper limit of the selected condition or the maximum value to use when establishing the threshold.
member.returns: When DstImageBufId is given an image buffer identifier, this function returns the specified value of the LowParam parameter. When DstImageBufId is set to M_NULL and the ConditionAndThreshMode parameter is set to one of the automatic threshold modes (M_BIMODAL, M_TRIANGLE_BISECTION_DARK, or M_TRIANGLE_BISECTION_BRIGHT), this function returns the automatically calculated threshold value. If the ConditionAndThreshMode parameter is set to M_PERCENTILE_VALUE, this function returns the threshold value established from the specified lower limit. When dealing with floating-point source buffers, the returned threshold is truncated to an integer value. Therefore, the returned threshold and the actual threshold used to binarize can differ.

member.name: M:Matrox.MatroxImagingLibrary.MIL.MmeasGetScore(Matrox.MatroxImagingLibrary.MIL_ID,System.Int64,Matrox.MatroxImagingLibrary.MIL_INT,System.Double@,System.Double@,System.Double@,System.Double@,System.Double@,Matrox.MatroxImagingLibrary.MIL_INT@,System.Int64)
member.summary: Retrieves information about the specified score characteristic.
member.param: Specifies the identifier of the measurement marker buffer.
Specifies the score characteristic about which to get information.
Specifies the index of the occurrence of a multiple-occurrence marker. This parameter must be set to one of the following values:

Specifies the address of the variable in which to write either the characteristic's resulting value (when using M_RESULT) or the characteristic's minimum acceptable limit, as indicated using MmeasSetScore with the Min parameter (when using M_MARKER).

Specifies the address of the variable in which to write either the characteristic's resulting score (when using M_RESULT) or the characteristic's lowest acceptable limit, as indicated using MmeasSetScore with the Low parameter (when using M_MARKER).

Specifies the address of the variable in which to write either the greatest value that MIL considers theoretically possible for the characteristic (when using M_RESULT) or the characteristic's highest acceptable limit, as indicated using MmeasSetScore with the High parameter (when using M_MARKER).

Specifies the address of the variable in which to write the characteristic's maximum acceptable limit, as indicated using MmeasSetScore with the Max parameter (when using M_MARKER); otherwise, you must specify M_NULL , indicating that MIL does not return any information to this parameter (when using M_RESULT).

Specifies the address of the variable in which to write the characteristic's score-offset, as indicated using MmeasSetScore with the ScoreOffset parameter (when using M_MARKER); otherwise, you must specify M_NULL , indicating that MIL does not return any information to this parameter (when using M_RESULT).

Specifies the address of the variable in which to write the characteristic's input units, as indicated using MmeasSetScore with the InputUnits parameter (when using M_MARKER); otherwise, you must specify M_NULL , indicating that MIL does not return any information to this parameter (when using M_RESULT).
Reserved for future expansion and must be set to M_DEFAULT .

member.param: Specifies the name and path of the file from which to restore the metrology context.
Specifies the system on which to restore the metrology context.

member.summary: Read the pixels along a specified arc, count the pixels, and store their values in a user-defined array.

Specifies the Y-coordinate of the ellipse center, relative to the top-left coordinate of the source buffer.

member.returns: The returned value is the number of pixels found along the arc.

member.param: Specifies the identifier of the 3D graphics list containing the 3D graphic about which to inquire information. You can inquire the settings of a 3D graphic in the 3D graphics list, as well as the default settings of the 3D graphics list itself.
Specifies the label of the 3D graphic to inquire. You can also inquire the default settings of the 3D graphics list itself.
Specifies the type of setting to inquire.
Specifies the address in which to write the requested information.
member.returns: The returned value is the requested information, cast to a MIL_INT64. If the requested information does not fit into a MIL_INT64, this function will return M_NULL or truncate the information.

member.name: M:Matrox.MatroxImagingLibrary.MILRaw.M3dregCalculate(System.Int64,System.Int64@,System.Int64,System.Int64,System.Int64)
member.summary: Perform the registration operation on the given point clouds and write the resulting transformation matrices into the pairwise 3D registration result buffer.
member.param: Specifies the identifier of the pairwise 3D registration context to use for the registration operation. The context must have been previously allocated using M3dregAlloc.

Specifies the address of the array containing the identifiers of the point cloud containers. The point clouds must be 3D-processable; use MbufInquireContainer with M_3D_PROCESSABLE to ensure that the containers contain 3D-processable point clouds. The number of containers supplied in the array should be less than or equal to the number of registration elements in the registration context.
Specifies the size of the array passed to ContainerBufIdArrayPtr.
Specifies the pairwise 3D registration result buffer identifier in which to store results. The result buffer must have been previously allocated using M3dregAllocResult.
Reserved for future expansion and must be set to M_DEFAULT .

Specifies the address of the array containing the identifiers of the point cloud containers. The point clouds must be 3D-processable; use MbufInquireContainer with M_3D_PROCESSABLE to ensure that the containers contain 3D-processable point clouds. The number of containers supplied in the array should be less than or equal to the number of registration elements in the registration context.
Specifies the size of the array passed to ContainerBufIdArrayPtr.
Specifies the pairwise 3D registration result buffer identifier in which to store results. The result buffer must have been previously allocated using M3dregAllocResult.
Reserved for future expansion and must be set to M_DEFAULT .

member.param: Specifies the identifier of the pairwise 3D registration result buffer. The pairwise 3D registration result buffer must have been successfully allocated using M3dregAllocResult, and contain the result of a successful call to M3dregCalculate.

Specifies the address of the array containing the identifiers of the point cloud containers. The point clouds must be 3D-processable. You can check that the point clouds are 3D-processable using MbufInquireContainer with M_3D_PROCESSABLE. You can set some entries in the array to M_NULL to merge a subset of the point clouds.
Specifies the size of the array passed to ContainerBufIdArrayPtr.

Specifies the identifier of the destination container in which to store the transformed and merged point clouds. The container must have been previously allocated using MbufAllocContainer with M_PROC.
Specifies the identifier of a 3D image processing subsampling context. This context is used to subsample the resulting point cloud after the merging is complete.
Specifies whether to merge points from all components (in all specified point clouds) with the same dimensions as the point cloud's M_COMPONENT_RANGE component.

member.name: M:Matrox.MatroxImagingLibrary.MILRaw.M3dregMerge(System.Int64,System.Int64[],System.Int64,System.Int64,System.Int64,System.Int64)

member.param: Specifies the identifier of the pairwise 3D registration result buffer. The pairwise 3D registration result buffer must have been successfully allocated using M3dregAllocResult, and contain the result of a successful call to M3dregCalculate.

Specifies the address of the array containing the identifiers of the point cloud containers. The point clouds must be 3D-processable. You can check that the point clouds are 3D-processable using MbufInquireContainer with M_3D_PROCESSABLE. You can set some entries in the array to M_NULL to merge a subset of the point clouds.
Specifies the size of the array passed to ContainerBufIdArrayPtr.

Specifies the identifier of the destination container in which to store the transformed and merged point clouds. The container must have been previously allocated using MbufAllocContainer with M_PROC.
Specifies the identifier of a 3D image processing subsampling context. This context is used to subsample the resulting point cloud after the merging is complete.
Specifies whether to merge points from all components (in all specified point clouds) with the same dimensions as the point cloud's M_COMPONENT_RANGE component.

member.name: M:Matrox.MatroxImagingLibrary.MILRaw.MbufImport(System.String,System.Int64,System.Int64,System.Int64,System.Int64@)
member.summary: Import data from a file into a data buffer or container.
member.param: Specifies the name and path of the file from which to import the data.
Specifies the file format.
Specifies the import operation.
Specifies the system on which to allocate the buffer or container for an M_RESTORE operation. For an M_LOAD operation, this parameter should be set to M_NULL .

Specifies the address of the variable containing the buffer or container identifier, for an M_LOAD operation, or the address of the variable in which to store the new buffer or container identifier (or specifies the data type that the function should use to return the buffer or container identifier), for an M_RESTORE operation.
member.returns: The returned value is the buffer or container identifier (for an M_RESTORE operation only) either as a standard identifier ( MIL_ID) or a smart identifier ( MIL_UNIQUE_BUF_ID). If restoration fails, M_NULL is returned (or nullptr ifM_UNIQUE_ID was specified).

member.param: Specifies the identifier of the source data buffer. The buffer must have been previously allocated on the required system using a function of the Buffer module (for example, MbufAllocColor or MbufImport).

member.name: M:Matrox.MatroxImagingLibrary.MILRaw.McodeModel(System.Int64,System.Int64,System.Int64,System.Int64,System.Int64,System.Int64@)
member.summary: Add, find, or delete a code model within a code context.
member.param: Specifies the code context in which to add, find, or delete the code model.
Specifies the operation to perform within the specified code context.
Specifies the code type of the code model to add or find in the code context. Note that if the Operation parameter is set to M_RESET_FROM_DETECTED_RESULTS or M_DELETE, set this parameter to M_NULL .

Specifies the instance or the index of the code model, depending on the operation and whether a specific code type is specified. Note that if the Operation parameter is set to M_ADD or M_DELETE, set this parameter to M_NULL .

Specifies the address in which to return or from which to read the code model identifier, depending on operation.

In the latter case, if the model already exists, the MIL identifier of the existing model will be returned. The returned value is M_NULL for an M_DELETE or anM_DELETE_ALL operation.

member.name: M:Matrox.MatroxImagingLibrary.MILRaw.MgenLutFunction(System.Int64,System.Int64,System.Double,System.Double,System.Double,System.Int64,System.Double,System.Int64)
member.summary: Generate data into a LUT buffer using a specified standard mathematical function, or a specified colormap (pseudo-color palette).
member.param: Specifies the identifier of the LUT in which to generate values.
Specifies the mathematical function or colormap to use for calculations.
Specifies the constant a for the specified mathematical function, or specifies a replacement value for the color assigned to index 0 of the LUT, if filling the LUT with a colormap.
Specifies the constant b for the specified mathematical function, or specifies a replacement value for the color assigned to the highest index of the LUT, if filling the LUT with a colormap.
Specifies the constant c for the specified mathematical function, if applicable. If filling the LUT with a colormap, set this to M_DEFAULT.
Specifies the first LUT index entry for which to generate values.
Specifies the initial value of x in the mathematical function. If filling the LUT with a colormap, set this to M_DEFAULT.
Specifies the last LUT index entry for which to generate values.

member.summary: Generate ramp data into a LUT buffer.
member.param: Specifies the identifier of the LUT in which to generate values.
Specifies the first LUT index for which to generate a value.
Specifies the starting value from which the increment is calculated; that is, the first LUT entry.
Specifies the last LUT index for which to generate a value.
Specifies the ending value from which the increment is calculated; that is, the last LUT entry.

member.name: M:Matrox.MatroxImagingLibrary.MILRaw.MgraAlloc(System.Int64,System.Int64@)
member.summary: Allocate a 2D graphics context.
member.param: Specifies the system on which to allocate the 2D graphics context.
Specifies the address of the variable in which to write the 2D graphics context identifier or specifies the data type that the function should use to return the 2D graphics context identifier.
member.returns: The returned value is the 2D graphics context identifier either as a standard identifier ( MIL_ID) or a smart identifier ( MIL_UNIQUE_GRA_ID). If allocation fails, M_NULL is returned (or nullptr ifM_UNIQUE_ID was specified).

Specifies the identifier of a valid image buffer containing the values corresponding to the displacements, in the Y-direction, of the vectors to draw.

Specifies a value that establishes the positions for which vectors are drawn. MIL always draws a vector for the first position (0,0), and then draws subsequent vectors that are a multiple of the specified stride, in both the X- and Y-direction. For example, if you specify a stride of 2, a vector is drawn for position (0,0), and for every second position after that, in the X-direction and in the Y-direction. Specifying a stride of 1 draws a vector for every position. Increasing the stride increases the space between the vectors drawn.
Specifies how to use the scale value ( ScaleValue) to scale the vectors.
Specifies the value by which to scale the vectors, according to the specified mode ( ScaleMode).
Specifies how to configure the arrowheads of the vectors, and how to handle null vectors.

member.name: M:Matrox.MatroxImagingLibrary.MILRaw.MmeasGetScore(System.Int64,System.Int64,System.Int64,System.Double@,System.Double@,System.Double@,System.Double@,System.Double@,System.Int64@,System.Int64)
member.summary: Retrieves information about the specified score characteristic.
member.param: Specifies the identifier of the measurement marker buffer.
Specifies the score characteristic about which to get information.
Specifies the index of the occurrence of a multiple-occurrence marker. This parameter must be set to one of the following values:

Specifies the address of the variable in which to write either the characteristic's resulting value (when using M_RESULT) or the characteristic's minimum acceptable limit, as indicated using MmeasSetScore with the Min parameter (when using M_MARKER).

Specifies the address of the variable in which to write either the characteristic's resulting score (when using M_RESULT) or the characteristic's lowest acceptable limit, as indicated using MmeasSetScore with the Low parameter (when using M_MARKER).

Specifies the address of the variable in which to write either the greatest value that MIL considers theoretically possible for the characteristic (when using M_RESULT) or the characteristic's highest acceptable limit, as indicated using MmeasSetScore with the High parameter (when using M_MARKER).

Specifies the address of the variable in which to write the characteristic's maximum acceptable limit, as indicated using MmeasSetScore with the Max parameter (when using M_MARKER); otherwise, you must specify M_NULL , indicating that MIL does not return any information to this parameter (when using M_RESULT).

Specifies the address of the variable in which to write the characteristic's score-offset, as indicated using MmeasSetScore with the ScoreOffset parameter (when using M_MARKER); otherwise, you must specify M_NULL , indicating that MIL does not return any information to this parameter (when using M_RESULT).

Specifies the address of the variable in which to write the characteristic's input units, as indicated using MmeasSetScore with the InputUnits parameter (when using M_MARKER); otherwise, you must specify M_NULL , indicating that MIL does not return any information to this parameter (when using M_RESULT).
Reserved for future expansion and must be set to M_DEFAULT .

member.param: Specifies the identifier of the MIL object about which to inquire. The MIL object can be a MIL utility object (allocated using MobjAlloc) or any other MIL object, except for MIL objects allocated using MfuncAlloc.

member.summary: Allocate an OCR font context.
member.param: Specifies the system on which to allocate the OCR font context.
Specifies the OCR font context type and the type of its font.
Specifies how many characters can be stored in the OCR font context.
Specifies the width of the characters in the OCR font context, in pixels.
Specifies the height of the characters in the OCR font context, in pixels.
Specifies the distance between the edge of each character and their surrounding cell, along the X-axis, in pixels.
Specifies the distance between the edge of each character and their surrounding cell, along the Y-axis, in pixels.
Specifies the width of the widest character in the font without its surrounding cell, in pixels.
Specifies the height of the tallest character in the font without its surrounding cell, in pixels.
Specifies the maximum thickness (stroke width) of the characters in the OCR font context.
Specifies the maximum length of the string that can be read or verified using the OCR font context.
Specifies whether the characters are brighter than the background.
Specifies the address of the variable in which to write the OCR font context identifier or specifies the data type that the function should use to return the OCR font context identifier.
member.returns: The returned value is the OCR font context identifier either as a standard identifier ( MIL_ID) or a smart identifier ( MIL_UNIQUE_OCR_ID). If allocation fails, M_NULL is returned (or nullptr ifM_UNIQUE_ID was specified).

Specifies the operation to be performed.
